##### Project general facts

Samana Waves is an ultra-high-end residential development by Samana Developers, located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The project comprises 213 luxury apartments across 26 floors, offering studios, one- and two-bedroom units, including duplex layouts with private pools. Designed to embody a resort-style lifestyle, the architecture features modern elegance, spacious interiors, panoramic elevators, and breathtaking views, creating a sophisticated and vibrant living environment for residents seeking comfort and exclusivity.

The development offers a wide range of premium amenities designed for leisure and wellness. Residents can enjoy a large leisure pool deck, a main swimming pool with water features, private pools in select units, a fully equipped health club, indoor and outdoor gyms, sauna and steam rooms, as well as dedicated kids’ play and swimming areas. Additional features such as green areas, jacuzzi, valet parking, and iconic cascading water elements enhance the overall lifestyle, delivering a luxurious and relaxing atmosphere.

The apartments are designed with contemporary layouts, featuring spacious living areas, modern kitchens, and high-quality finishes. Select units include private pools, adding an exclusive touch to everyday living. The interiors are crafted to reflect a stylish and functional living space, combining comfort with modern design elements. Kitchens are fully equipped, while the overall finishing emphasizes quality materials and elegant detailing. Furnishing: No.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, just next to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and near Dubai International Stadium, this exceptional location offers residents easy access to everything needed for everyday life. The community is strategically positioned near key destinations including Dubai Miracle Garden, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to a wealth of amenities, including schools, medical facilities, convenience stores, shopping centres, and golf courses. The area offers direct access to the main highway, ensuring seamless connectivity to all parts of the city. Whether for work, leisure, or family life, every essential is within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
